scope: Synthetic tagged structural integer controls; not a real-LZ or production-format result.

source.language: Rust std only; outside Cargo and production source

strong.description: eight values 0,1,4,16,64,255,u64::MAX,8 repeated 32 times; tags cycle; tail=tail

weak.description: six small frequent values; every ninth is xorshift64 value masked to 10 bits; tags cycle; tail=t

absent.description: xorshift64 values masked to 16 bits; tags cycle; tail=t

archive.crc32_scope: all bytes after magic through the final tail byte
archive.rice_wire_rule: regular cost is q+k+2 bits; raw escape cost is 65 bits; use raw iff q > 63-k, preserve the equal-cost regular form, and reject the opposite noncanonical form while decoding

execution.fresh_decoder: new process; archive and output path only; parent byte-compares restored source
